user.title: Proof account
user.description: Sign in with your Proof app account. You must use the phone number you log in to the mobile app with — email addresses are not accepted. A verification code will be sent to that number by SMS.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Enter the code that was just sent by SMS to {username}.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Proof
reauth_confirm.description: The Proof session for {username} has expired. Confirm your password and a new SMS code will be sent.

error.invalid_code: That verification code was rejected. Note that only the newest code is valid — if you requested more than one, use the most recent SMS, or start again to get a new code.
error.invalid_auth: The password was rejected by the Proof cloud. Check it and a new code will be sent.
error.invalid_phone: The Proof cloud does not recognise this phone number. Use the number you sign in to the mobile app with.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Proof cloud

abort.already_configured: This Proof account is already configured
